method: Original encoded frames decoded without resampling. ffprobe best_effort_timestamp_time gives the original 25fps timestamps. Adjacent source frames were visually inspected for the first indicated ink extension or hit burst; native accepted sound events supply the wall timestamps. These are measured per-scene anchors, not a guessed wall-clock offset.
frameNumbering: Zero-based encoded frame index from ffprobe -show_frames.

anchors.measurement: First extended blue fish-body stroke. Frame98 contains the initial dot; frame99 first shows its extension, matching the first accepted ink callback after pointer motion.
First gold impact burst and damage16 over the opponent. Immediately preceding frame1158 has no impact or damage number.
First extended coral hammer stroke. Frame1697 contains the initial coral dot; frame1698 first shows the descending extension, matching the first accepted ink callback after pointer motion.
First gold impact burst and damage14 over the opponent. Immediately preceding frame3172 has no impact or damage number.
